Name: Kenneth's Vast Farm - Super Tall
Author: Kf29
Description:
[size=4][b]I love vertical farms - you just keep running down and there's always more space.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]This is 80x195 = 15,600 tiles, triple vanilla. Same width as normal, but 3x taller. If you like to separate crops by rows going downwards - top for spring crops, middle for kegs, bottom for barns - this layout is perfect.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]All tillable, you can plant the whole map.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Inside you get:[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]- Standard: Use if you already have a save, replaces Standard Farm.[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]- Additional Farms: For new games, shows as custom type. Has Day 1 mail that returns furniture if it disappeared from the old bug (now fixed).[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Install: SMAPI + Content Patcher, drop in Mods. Works with 1.6 / Android.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]This one is Kenneth's Vast Farm - Super Tall.[/b][/size]
